items.question: If a customer returns two AED 20 products from an AED 60 order paid partly by voucher and partly by card, how much of the AED 40 refund goes back to the card?
items.gold: AED 20 (a Credit or Debit Card refund of AED 20).
items.fact: Partial return refund split between voucher and card, card gets AED 20
